messages:
Raj SRE: Kicking off a scoped kernel+driver+fw validation tomorrow 07:30 PT on a tiny canary pool. Aim: reduce Xid regressions and noisy ECC spikes. Will need triage + one person to run automation.

Lin Infra: I can be on the automation run. What's the canary size?

Raj SRE: Canary = 2 nodes per AZ in us-west-2 + 1 node in eu-central-1. GPUs: mixed T4s/A10G with one A100 per AZ at restricted concurrency. Bundle: kernel 6.7.14-rc, driver 545.16, fw 1.4.0b.

Nora HW: Pre-check hardware health: capture `nvme SMART`, `lspci -vvv` and `nvidia-smi -q -x`. If any GPU shows persistent corrected ECC > 3 post-upgrade, mark for replacement.

Theo ML: Recommend steady inference profile (chat + batch embeddings) for 20m + two 60s high-tps bursts. I'll produce the request script.

Lin Infra: Acceptance thresholds proposal: Xid > 0 within 15m = fail for that GPU unless isolated transient (single Xid with immediate recovery). ECC corrected delta > 5 = fail. Any uncorrectable ECC = immediate drain. More than 1 GPU reset in 20m -> escalate.

Raj SRE: Agreed. Add PCIe/Link errors as a failure signal: `cat /sys/class/pci_bus/*/error_*` and `dmesg` grep for `GPU`/`NVRM`.

Theo ML: I'll run perf baseline before upgrade and post-upgrade; capture p95/p99 latency and tokens/sec. We should fail if perf drops >10% under identical burst.

Lin Infra: Triage commands I'm going to run:
`sudo dmesg | tail -n 200 | grep -i -E 'Xid|NVRM|GPU' || true`
`nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,UTILIZATION > /tmp/gpu-snap-$ROLLID.txt`
`nvidia-smi -q -x > /tmp/gpu-$HOST-$ROLLID.xml`
`journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 --no-pager`

Nora HW: Also capture `ethtool -S` and `smartctl -a /dev/nvme0n1` for NIC/SSD errors in case host-level faults correlate.

Raj SRE: Canary rollout id = 2026-07-01-canary1. infra-bot will apply the image to selected nodepools at 07:30 PT. Please tag S3 artifacts with rollout id.

infra-bot: scheduled apply image bundle kernel=6.7.14-rc driver=545.16 fw=1.4.0b to nodepool=gpu-canary at 2026-07-01T07:30:00-07:00. Reminder 10m before.

Theo ML: Collector plan: sample `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu,memory.used --format=csv` every 10s and push tar to `s3://redwood-gpu-ops/validation/2026-07-01-canary1/` with metadata.json including node, gpu_serial, rollout_id.

Lin Infra: Drain/replace flow (SOP): annotate node `kubectl annotate node/<node> redwood/replace=1`, cordon, drain, snapshot `nvidia-smi -q -x`, upload. Use annotation so autoscaler allocates a different host.

Nora HW: For repeated Xid 31/43 on same serial, open hw ticket and tag `hw:hot-swap`. For Xid 13/78 note firmware class, escalate if it repeats >2 times across different kernels.

Raj SRE: Observability: set a temporary alert for this rollout: corrected_ecc_delta > 5 for 15m OR xid_count_in_window > 0 for 10m -> page infra oncall. Theo, can you add that?

Theo ML: Yep. I'll add a Grafana alert and a short dashboard showing per-gpu Xid, corrected ECC delta, resets, and thermal trends.

Lin Infra: One operational note: prefer soft GPU reset via `nvidia-smi --gpu-reset -i <id>` if safe. Do NOT attempt if kernel oops present; escalate to Nora.

Raj SRE: Volunteers: Lin (automation + triage), Theo (metrics + perf), Nora (hw backup). I'll coordinate and post a quick postmortem summary in #incidents after run.

infra-bot: reminder set for 2026-07-01T07:20:00-07:00 for thread 1767890123.

Theo ML: I'll push the request scripts and perf baseline by EOD today. Lin, ping me if you need payload tuning.

Nora HW: I'll be on-call during the 07:30-10:00 PT window for any hardware escalations.

Lin Infra: TL;DR: run canary bundle, watch Xid/ECC + PCIe errors, drain & replace serials with repeats, tag everything with rollout id, and escalate if >1 reset or uncorrectable ECC. :thumbsup:
